g.text: UML sequence - Implemented simulated outgoing submission (WP-21)
Verified SIMULATED recipient; exact quote; action reauthentication; confirmation
Save original accepted intent before scheduling
Lock original intent, recipient and current rail policy
Current ownership, restrictions, proof and signed checks
Release only a bound, unsubmitted reservation if present
Reserve exact principal + fee and gross daily budget
Payer lock; expiry / product / pricing / funds / budget checks
Immutable reservation authority and active hold
Mark bound hold submitted before any possible HTTP effect
Persist attempt marker + fenced, short lease
Deduplicate identity + digest; persist acceptance + immutable evidence
Current role; serialize policy revision; pause immediately
Recover original durable work / expired lease
Signed inquiry of original identity, also while paused
Retrieve original instruction and immutable current evidence
Recheck fence after locks; save current pending / reconciliation status
Unknown outcome and NOT_FOUND never release submitted funds.
Provider acknowledgement does not establish settlement.
Final evidence proceeds through the independent Core booking/release path.
Propose resume bound to exact policy and revision
Independent canonical person approves exact proposal
Current maker and checker authority; exact approval digest
Recheck current revision; resume only new submissions
